Name: LeiAili's Revisions for Seasonal Outfits - Linus
Author: LeiAili
Description:
This mod revises Linus' spring portraits from the mod [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5450]Seasonal Outfits - Slightly Cuter Aesthetic[/url].﻿ I felt like it was out of character for Linus as a survivalist/naturalist to wear normal clothing, no matter how worn out it is. Plus, it didn't really go with his other seasonal outfits. So I made a new outfit for him for spring, based on the vanilla design, but with green leaves instead of yellow ones, because it's spring.

All credit for the original mod goes to [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/2679113]Poltergeister[/url]. Credit to ConcernedApe for the original portrait.

[b][size=3]YOU MUST INSTALL SEASONAL OUTFITS MOD FIRST IN ORDER FOR THIS MOD TO WORK.[/size]

[/b]
[size=5]Changes included:[/size]

[list]
[*]Updated Linus' portrait and sprite for spring. No other outfits were changed.
[/list]  
[size=5]Installation:[/size]
 [list]
[*][b]DO NOT USE A MOD MANAGER. [/b]Download mod manually and unzip.
[*]Copy the "assets" folder into the Seasonal Outfits mod folder (most likely C:\Program Files\Steam\steamapps\common\Stardew Valley\Mods\[CP] Seasonal Cute Characters) and overwrite all changes.
[*]Run game as normal
[/list] 
 
Hope you enjoy my mod! Please feel free to comment if you have any feedback, or if something doesn't work. Thank you!
